messages:
maria (PM): quick async check — payments + routing milestone status please. what shipped, what slipped, owners, deps, blockers, next steps? cc @aj @sarah :wave:

aj (Eng): payments-api v1 canary deployed yesterday (1% traffic). no obvious errors so far. small header parsing bug left in CR that blocks full rollout — @li to merge. ETA end of day today. :ok_hand:

li (Eng): on it. parser fallback fix is tiny: use header.get('x-user') instead of header['x-user']. PR #4281 open. will merge after one quick review and green tests.

sarah (Eng Lead): routing pipeline slipped — perf regression after batcher tweak. KV cache eviction seems to be evicting hot keys too aggressively. working with eng-ml to retune eviction thresholds. owner: sarah. updated ETA: end of week (Fri).

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deployment completed for payments-v1 on us-west-2 (build 20260315-88).

niko (PM): can we add a rollback plan + alerting in case regression spikes? request: latency > 1200ms or 5xx > 0.5% triggers pager + comms.

aj (Eng): added rollback runbook in repo (docs/runbooks/payments-rollback.md). snippet: `rdeploy rollback payments-v1 --to=20260312-77`

maria (PM): thanks. sarah — customer impact? need comms now or wait for metrics?

sarah (Eng Lead): no immediate customer-facing errors. internal retries increased but autoscaling absorbed load. we'll prep a short comms draft if 5xx breaches 0.5% or latency >1200ms for 10m.

ben (Product Ops): note: analytics migration (#302) is blocking final milestone analytics — owner @emma. is that still on track?

emma (Data Eng): migration hit schema drift during validation. ETA +3 days. running a nightly backfill for last 7 days as a workaround; will surface any failed rows to the migration dashboard.

maria (PM): action items summary: 1) @li merge PR #4281 today; 2) @sarah continue perf tune (ETA EOW), post perf numbers; 3) @emma run migration +3d and complete backfill; 4) @aj ensure alert + rollback runbook linked in milestone doc. anything else blocking? please ack here. :spiral_note_pad:

li (Eng): :thumbsup: merging after tests pass.

sarah (Eng Lead): :eyes: will post perf numbers by Thu and update eviction params in canary.

emma (Data Eng): ack — backfill started, will post logs if errors show up.

aj (Eng): :thumbsup: alert dashboard created, runbook linked at /runbooks/payments-rollback.md, and I tagged on-call for the first 24h.

maria (PM): great — i'll capture this in the milestone doc and tag for the quarterly sync. will ping again if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
